name: North Tide's Run
summary: North Tide's Run is the windswept northwestern shoreline of Silverpine Forest, skirting the edge of the Great Sea. Marked by a lonely campfire and a half-sunken shipwreck, this stretch of sand is known as a secluded trial ground for traveling druids seeking harmony with the waters.

sections.title: A Lonely Coastal Outpost
sections.body: Stretching along the northwest edge of Silverpine Forest, North Tide's Run consists of cold sand, pounding surf, and a strip of the Great Sea. Its most unmistakable landmark is a partially submerged shipwreck tilted precariously in the shallows near the beach. Aside from the wreckage, the only sign of habitation is a humble campfire tended by Wallace the Blind, who keeps a quiet vigil beside the lapping tide.

sections.title: Waters of the Sea Lion
sections.body: Despite its bleak atmosphere, North Tide's Run holds sacred importance for Horde initiates walking the path of Cenarius. Young tauren druids are directed here on pilgrimage to recover underwater relics lost to the waves, testing their lung capacity and endurance to earn the blessing of the aquatic form.

faq.answer: It is the northwestern shoreline and coastal shelf of Silverpine Forest, bordered by the Great Sea. It is characterized by its sunken ship, tidal waters, and bleak, quiet strand.

aliases: who is the guy at the fire
faq.answer: Wallace the Blind is a hermit who has pitched a small camp and fire right at the water's edge along the beach, sitting quietly near the sunken vessel.

faq.q: Why do druids come to North Tide's Run?
faq.answer: Tauren druids travel here on pilgrimage during their trials to commune with the spirits of the sea. By braving the depths near the shoreline to recover lost pendant fragments, they earn the power to assume aquatic form.

faq.q: What is the sunken ship in the water?
faq.answer: The wreck is a partially submerged vessel resting in the shallows just off the sand. Its presence serves as a navigational landmark for travelers combing the coast.

angles.text: For tauren druids, this cold coast represents a vital rite of passage, housing the submerged trial components necessary to master the sea lion form.
Far from the warm plains of Mulgore, North Tide's Run is one of the few places in Lordaeron that young tauren travel to early in their spiritual journeys.
